import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Price vs Megapixels (scatter)
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
scatter = ax1.scatter(data['megapixels'], data['price_usd'], 
                     s=data['weight_grams']/3, alpha=0.6, 
                     c=range(len(data)), cmap='viridis')
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Price vs Megapixels\n(size = weight)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 2. Brand distribution (bar)
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
brand_counts = data['brand'].value_counts()
bars = ax2.bar(brand_counts.index, brand_counts.values, color=plt.cm.Set3(range(len(brand_counts))))
ax2.set_xlabel('Brand', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Cameras by Brand', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 3. Sensor Type distribution (pie)
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
sensor_counts = data['sensor_type'].value_counts()
colors = plt.cm.Pastel1(range(len(sensor_counts)))
ax3.pie(sensor_counts.values, labels=sensor_counts.index, autopct='%1.0f%%', 
        colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('Sensor Type Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Price by Brand (box plot)
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
data_sorted = data.sort_values('brand')
brands = data_sorted['brand'].unique()
price_by_brand = [data_sorted[data_sorted['brand'] == brand]['price_usd'].values for brand in brands]
bp = ax4.boxplot(price_by_brand, labels=brands, patch_artist=True)
for patch, color in zip(bp['boxes'], plt.cm.Set2(range(len(brands)))):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)
ax4.set_xlabel('Brand', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('Price Distribution by Brand', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 5. Weight vs Max ISO (scatter)
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
colors_iso = data['has_video_4k'].map({0: 'coral', 1: 'steelblue'})
ax5.scatter(data['weight_grams'], data['max_iso'], c=colors_iso, s=100, alpha=0.6, edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax5.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_ylabel('Max ISO', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_title('Weight vs Max ISO\n(Blue=4K, Red=No 4K)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 6. Body Type distribution (horizontal bar)
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
body_counts = data['body_type'].value_counts()
colors_body = plt.cm.Set3(range(len(body_counts)))
ax6.barh(body_counts.index, body_counts.values, color=colors_body)
ax6.set_xlabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_ylabel('Body Type', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_title('Body Type Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 7. Model Year Timeline (scatter)
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
ax7.scatter(data['model_year'], data['price_usd'], s=150, alpha=0.6, 
           c=range(len(data)), cmap='coolwarm', edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax7.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_title('Price vs Model Year', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 8. Lens Mount distribution (bar)
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
mount_counts = data['lens_mount'].value_counts()
bars = ax8.bar(mount_counts.index, mount_counts.values, color=plt.cm.Paired(range(len(mount_counts))))
ax8.set_xlabel('Lens Mount', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_title('Lens Mount Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 9. Summary Statistics Table
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
ax9.axis('off')
summary_stats = pd.DataFrame({
    'Metric': ['Avg Price', 'Avg MP', 'Avg Weight', 'Avg ISO', '4K Video'],
    'Value': [
        f"${data['price_usd'].mean():.0f}",
        f"{data['megapixels'].mean():.1f}",
        f"{data['weight_grams'].mean():.0f}g",
        f"{data['max_iso'].mean():.0f}",
        f"{data['has_video_4k'].sum()}/{len(data)}"
    ]
})
table = ax9.table(cellText=summary_stats.values, colLabels=summary_stats.columns,
                  cellLoc='center', loc='center', bbox=[0, 0, 1, 1])
table.auto_set_font_size(False)
table.set_fontsize(9)
table.scale(1, 2)
for i in range(len(summary_stats) + 1):
    if i == 0:
        table[(i, 0)].set_facecolor('#4CAF50')
        table[(i, 1)].set_facecolor('#4CAF50')
        table[(i, 0)].set_text_props(weight='bold', color='white')
        table[(i, 1)].set_text_props(weight='bold', color='white')
    else:
        table[(i, 0)].set_facecolor('#E8F5E9')
        table[(i, 1)].set_facecolor('#F5F5F5')
ax9.set_title('Summary Statistics', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', pad=20)

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Camera Dataset Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
